title: GIG-1134: Return In Output For Cortex CLI Commands
description: Adds an optional success field to ngramx.yml custom commands so configured text is printed to stdout when a command completes successfully.

test_plan.description: Optional success text prints on successful custom commands
steps: In a project ngramx.yml, add success: "All tests passed" under an existing commands entry (e.g. test)
Run that command via ngramx (e.g. ngramx test) and confirm it completes successfully
Confirm stdout shows All tests passed instead of Command completed successfully (Xs)
Remove the success key, re-run, and confirm the default completion line returns
From the ngramx checkout: php vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Command/DynamicCommandTest.php
